candidate_ideas.statement: Identify W_5 with omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D) for a divisor D in a balanced tetragonal g^1_4, thereby interpreting the marked divisor as residual to D in a canonical divisor.

Construct the rank-drop locus over the moduli of balanced tetragonal structures as the reduced-support open of the relative linear system |W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}|, followed by the finite etale ordering cover.
Stratify the relative degree-six linear system by h^0(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}) and determine every stratum's components, dimensions, stabilizers, and map to tetragonal moduli.
For a free tetragonal pencil D with h^0(O_C(D))=2, Riemann-Roch suggests h^0(omega_C(-D))=3 and hence a P^2-family of residual degree-six divisors.
Use localization and Gysin maps to isolate the exact contributions of the rank-drop locus to Gr^W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q).
Reduce the lowest-weight cohomology of all relevant strata and coefficient systems to explicitly controlled configuration or Hurwitz spaces.
Prove that every exact codimension-13 contribution supported on the rank-drop locus is a sum of Q(-13).

established_facts.evidence: FND-0001, mechanically verified for all cases.
established_facts.statement: For d=3g-3+n, Poincare duality identifies W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n};Q) with W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n};Q)(d).
For (g,n)=(6,6), d=21 and the ordinary cohomological degree corresponding to the Borel-Moore target is 26.

established_facts.evidence: SRC-0004, Lemma 10.6 degree calculation, including the negative sign in gamma^*O(-f).
established_facts.statement: With W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O_{P1}(-f))|_C, one has deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f.

established_facts.evidence: Substitution into deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f gives 16, followed by 16-deg(omega_C)=16-10=6.
established_facts.statement: For g=6 and f=5, deg(W_5)=16 and deg(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1})=6.
For a marked divisor Gamma of degree six, deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma))=0, whereas deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma))=-4.

established_facts.evidence: Its defining line bundle has degree -4, and a line bundle of negative degree on a smooth projective curve has no nonzero global section.
established_facts.statement: The f=4 obstruction space H^0(C,omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) vanishes.

established_facts.evidence: The obstruction line bundle has degree zero; a degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective curve has a nonzero section exactly when it is trivial.
established_facts.statement: For the f=5 summand, H^0(C,omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) is nonzero exactly when O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}.

established_facts.evidence: FND-0035 explicitly places (6,6) at virtual cohomological dimension.
established_facts.statement: The degree 26 target equals the virtual cohomological dimension for M_{6,6}, so vanishing strictly above virtual cohomological dimension does not settle it.
For M_{6,6} to M_{6,5}, the q=0 term H^{26}(M_{6,5};Q) vanishes, and no Leray differential enters or leaves total degree 26 when fibre cohomology is confined to q=0,1.

established_facts.evidence: The canonical geometric bottleneck explicitly specifies the reduced-support open and its finite etale S_6-cover.
established_facts.statement: The reduced-distinct-support locus in a degree-six relative linear system is open, and ordering its six support points gives a finite etale S_6-cover.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Already M_{0,4} is P^1 minus three points and has nonzero H^1; mixed-Tate cohomology does not imply concentration in even degrees.
invalid_steps.statement: M_{0,b} has cohomology only in even degrees.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Transfer makes the base cohomology a direct summand of the cover's cohomology, not conversely; the cover may acquire additional non-Tate summands.
invalid_steps.statement: An arbitrary finite etale cover of a space with pure-Tate cohomology also has pure-Tate cohomology.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Finiteness alone gives no such control on the new cohomology or monodromy of the covering space.
invalid_steps.statement: Being finite over an open subset of M_{0,b} is sufficient to make every lowest-weight cohomology group of a Hurwitz space Tate.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Riemann-Roch gives h^0(L)-h^1(L)=1, hence h^0(L)=1+h^1(L) is at least one.
invalid_steps.statement: The h^0-stratification of a degree-six line bundle L with chi(L)=1 can contain an r=0 stratum.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Non-Tate variations of weight zero can occur; finite-monodromy weight-zero systems must be analyzed separately rather than excluded by a positive-weight estimate.
invalid_steps.statement: Every non-Tate geometric variation necessarily has weight at least one.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A Gysin map may vanish or kill the relevant class, and survival in the exact degree and weight requires an explicit nonzero class and control of all differentials and boundary maps.
invalid_steps.statement: The existence of a non-Tate local system on a stratum would by itself produce a surviving non-Tate summand after a Gysin map.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The degree computation controls only the specified summands in the stated tetragonal construction; it does not exclude other geometric strata or coefficient systems without an exhaustive argument.
invalid_steps.statement: The absence of the f=4 obstruction proves that the f=5 residual condition is the unique global source of the target cohomology.

reusable_computations.statement: deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma))=4*5+6-2*6-14=0; for f=4 it is 4*4+6-2*6-14=-4.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: A proof of the identification W_5 isomorphic to omega_C^{tensor 2}(-D), with the correct Casnati-Ekedahl convention and signs, is required.
The balanced tetragonal moduli space, its components, dimension, splitting-type locus, and forgetful map to M_6 require rigorous construction and verification.
Every h^0-stratum of the relative degree-six linear system requires a complete component and dimension analysis, including hyperelliptic, trigonal, nonreduced-support, and other special loci.
The exact cohomology and monodromy of the relevant Hurwitz covers and finite ordering covers must be controlled; Tate cohomology cannot be inferred merely from finiteness over M_{0,b}.
The Casnati-Ekedahl resolution must be shown to compute the exact lowest-weight degree-26 contribution on the complementary open locus.

The localization or Gysin spectral sequence for the chosen stratification must be constructed with correct degree, weight, and Tate-twist conventions, and all relevant differentials must be controlled.
Weight-zero nonconstant local systems and finite-monodromy representations on every contributing stratum require explicit analysis.
Tate type for the exact codimension-13 contribution supported on the rank-drop locus remains to be proved.
After controlling the supported contribution, its assembly with the complementary open contribution in Gr^W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q) remains to be justified.
